title: Payment API Connection Pool Starvation Under Spike
description: Payment API began throwing HTTP 500 responses with database connection pool exhausted errors during flash sale peak traffic.
error_message: TimeoutError: QueuePool limit of size 20 overflow 10 reached, connection timed out, timeout 30.00
logs:
2026-08-14 14:22:01 ERROR [payment-api] [pool.py:302] Connection pool exhausted: 30/30 active connections in use
2026-08-14 14:22:05 ERROR [payment-api] [checkout.py:118] HTTP 500: Database connection timeout while processing order pay_99482
2026-08-14 14:22:10 WARN [payment-api] [health.py:44] Health check degraded: latency 4200ms
root_cause: Database connection pool size was capped at 20 with overflow 10, causing connection starvation when simultaneous payment requests spiked above 1200 req/sec.
resolution_steps:
1. Verified active DB connection count and idle thread locks.
2. Executed restart of payment-api connection pool service.
3. Scaled connection pool max size to 50.
4. Verified service health and 0% error rate.
engineer_feedback: Restarting the connection pool immediately cleared the hung socket threads and restored healthy checkout processing.

title: Auth Service JWT Signing Key Rotation Cache Invalidation Desync
description: Users received 401 Unauthorized errors across all downstream APIs following scheduled JWT key rotation.
error_message: JWTVerificationError: Signature verification failed for key ID 'key_2026_q3_b'. Public key not found in local JWKS cache.
logs:
2026-07-11 09:00:15 ERROR [auth-service] [jwt.py:84] Failed to verify bearer token: key ID key_2026_q3_b missing in key cache
2026-07-11 09:00:18 ERROR [auth-service] [routes.py:55] HTTP 401 Unauthorized for user_88329
2026-07-11 09:00:22 WARN [auth-service] JWKS cache refresh TTL 86400s blocking key pickup
root_cause: JWKS cache TTL was set to 24 hours without an automated pub/sub eviction hook, preventing new public key ingestion after rotation.
resolution_steps:
1. Ran JWKS cache purge tool.
2. Executed rolling restart of auth-service pods.
3. Verified token verification success rate returned to 100%.
engineer_feedback: Flushing the auth JWKS redis cache and restarting auth-service quickly resolved the 401 outage.

title: Order Service Out-of-Memory (OOM) Crash Loop in Batch Exporter
description: Order service container repeatedly crash-looped with exit code 137 (OOMKilled) when generating end-of-day invoice batch exports.
error_message: ContainerKilled: OOMKilled - Process 1 exceeded memory limit 1024MiB, consumed 1150MiB
logs:
2026-06-20 23:45:10 WARN [order-service] Memory usage reached 95% (972MB / 1024MB)
2026-06-20 23:45:15 ERROR [order-service] Memory allocation failed during DataFrame export of 450,000 order records
2026-06-20 23:45:18 FATAL [k8s] Pod order-service-7f98b-q2k9p terminated with OOMKilled
root_cause: Batch exporter loaded the entire unpaginated table of 450k orders into in-memory pandas dataframe instead of streaming cursor batches.
resolution_steps:
1. Rolled back deployment to v3.1.1.
2. Increased container memory limit to 2048MiB temporarily.
3. Verified pod stabilization and order checkout continuity.
engineer_feedback: Rolling back to v3.1.1 stopped the OOM loop immediately until batch streaming fix was merged.

title: Database Service Deadlock on Concurrent Inventory Decrement
description: High rate of transaction deadlocks on PostgreSQL inventory table leading to cascading timeouts in checkout workflows.
error_message: PostgresError: deadlock detected - Process 28192 waits for ShareLock on transaction 91283; blocked by process 28198
logs:
2026-05-04 11:15:30 ERROR [database-service] Deadlock detected: TX_91283 and TX_91290 conflicting on inventory row locks
2026-05-04 11:15:33 WARN [database-service] Active queries blocked: 42 connections waiting in lock queue
root_cause: Unsorted row lock acquisition in multi-item cart inventory deduction caused circular lock dependency.
resolution_steps:
1. Terminated blocking backend PID connections.
2. Enabled row locking order canonicalization in application layer.
3. Verified lock wait latency normalized below 5ms.
engineer_feedback: Terminating the hung backend lock transactions stopped the cascading thread pileup.

title: User Service Redis Session Cache Eviction Thundering Herd
description: Redis master node memory saturation triggered volatile-lru mass eviction, causing 50,000 user sessions to query PostgreSQL simultaneously.
error_message: RedisError: OOM command not allowed when used memory > 'maxmemory' (4GB limit reached)
logs:
2026-04-18 16:10:02 ERROR [user-service] [redis.py:102] Redis memory reached 100% maxmemory (4096MB)
2026-04-18 16:10:05 WARN [user-service] Fallback triggered: querying relational database for user profile and session
2026-04-18 16:10:12 ERROR [database-service] DB CPU 98% under 20x normal read query volume
root_cause: Session tokens were stored without TTL expiration alongside telemetry payloads, filling Redis to max capacity.
resolution_steps:
1. Executed Redis cache purge of orphaned telemetry keys.
2. Restarted user-service cache connection pool.
3. Scaled Redis maxmemory to 8GB.
4. Verified DB CPU fell back to 14%.
engineer_feedback: Purging orphaned keys and restarting connection pool recovered the system rapidly.

title: Payment API Gateway Timeout on Stripe Webhook Processing
description: Stripe webhook receivers were timing out at 30 seconds due to synchronous fraud verification microservice latency.
error_message: HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout: Upstream fraud-check service did not respond within 30000ms
logs:
2026-03-29 08:33:10 ERROR [payment-api] [webhook.py:72] 504 Gateway Timeout handling event evt_1Ok2934
2026-03-29 08:33:14 ERROR [payment-api] Upstream dependency fraud-check latency at 32.4s (SLO 200ms)
root_cause: External fraud score service degradation blocked synchronous webhook execution thread.
resolution_steps:
1. Enabled asynchronous webhook queuing mode via feature flag.
2. Restarted payment-api webhook worker pool.
3. Verified webhook acknowledgment response time dropped to 45ms.
engineer_feedback: Switching to asynchronous processing decoupled webhooks from slow fraud checks.

title: Auth Service Rate Limiter Leaky Bucket Denial of Service
description: Legitimate login attempts received 429 Too Many Requests due to IP aggregation bug behind Cloudflare proxy.
error_message: HTTP 429: Too Many Requests - Global rate limit exceeded for client 127.0.0.1
logs:
2026-02-15 13:40:00 WARN [auth-service] Rate limiter triggered: 450 requests in 60s from remote IP 10.0.0.1
2026-02-15 13:40:05 ERROR [auth-service] Cloudflare CF-Connecting-IP header ignored, using internal proxy IP
root_cause: Proxy header trust setting was reverted in configuration update, treating all traffic as single client IP.
resolution_steps:
1. Updated rate limit trust header config to use CF-Connecting-IP.
2. Restarted auth-service.
3. Verified 429 rate dropped to 0.01%.
engineer_feedback: Config update and quick service restart resolved false-positive rate limiting.

title: Order Service Kafka Consumer Group Rebalance Storm
description: Order processing lag reached 120,000 messages as consumer group continuously rebalanced and stalled partition consumption.
error_message: CommitFailedException: Commit cannot be completed since the group has already rebalanced and assigned the partitions to another member
logs:
2026-01-22 17:15:00 WARN [order-service] [consumer.py:89] Heartbeat timeout 45000ms exceeded by consumer order-worker-3
2026-01-22 17:15:04 ERROR [order-service] Rebalance in progress, partition assignment revoked
root_cause: Long-running PDF generation task blocked the consumer polling loop longer than max.poll.interval.ms.
resolution_steps:
1. Increased max.poll.interval.ms from 30000 to 180000ms.
2. Restarted order-service consumer group.
3. Verified consumer group stabilized and queue drained within 6 minutes.
engineer_feedback: Adjusting poll interval and restarting consumer group stopped rebalance thrashing.

title: User Service Corrupted Profile JSON Deserialization
description: User profile endpoint returned 500 error for users with unicode emoji avatars.
error_message: UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0xf0 in position 14: invalid continuation byte
logs:
2025-12-10 10:05:12 ERROR [user-service] [serde.py:44] JSON decode error for user_id=98214: invalid UTF-8 byte stream
2025-12-10 10:05:14 ERROR [user-service] HTTP 500 Internal Server Error in GET /api/v1/users/profile
root_cause: Latin-1 encoding fallback in legacy serializer corrupted 4-byte UTF-8 emoji strings.
resolution_steps:
1. Rolled back deployment to v1.9.8.
2. Verified profile endpoints returned 200 OK for affected users.
engineer_feedback: Rolling back immediately stopped 500 errors for unicode profiles.

title: Database Service WAL Disk Space Saturation
description: Postgres database entered read-only recovery mode due to 100% disk utilization on /var/lib/postgresql/data/pg_wal.
error_message: PANIC: could not write to log file 00000001000000A200000014: No space left on device
logs:
2025-11-03 04:12:00 FATAL [database-service] Disk usage on WAL partition reached 99.8%
2025-11-03 04:12:05 ERROR [database-service] Archive command failed: s3 backup timeout, WAL segments accumulating
root_cause: Stuck S3 archiver script prevented Postgres from deleting archived WAL files, exhausting 100GB disk volume.
resolution_steps:
1. Restarted Postgres archive process and cleaned old archived logs.
2. Increased storage volume to 250GB.
3. Verified Postgres transitioned out of read-only mode to healthy read-write.
engineer_feedback: Restarting archiver and clearing archived segments restored read-write database service.

title: Payment API SSL Certificate Expiration on Payment Gateway Egress
description: All payment gateway outgoing HTTPS calls failed with SSL certificate verify failed: certificate has expired.
error_message: SSLError: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate has expired (_ssl.c:1129)
logs:
2025-10-14 00:01:00 ERROR [payment-api] [client.py:90] SSL Handshake failure contacting api.stripe.com
2025-10-14 00:01:05 ERROR [payment-api] Payment intent creation failed: SSL certificate validation error
root_cause: Base Docker container OS ca-certificates bundle expired at midnight without auto-renewal cron.
resolution_steps:
1. Deployed hotfix with updated ca-certificates package.
2. Executed restart of payment-api service.
3. Verified payment transactions processed successfully.
engineer_feedback: Updated cert trust store and restarted payment service. Resolved.

title: Auth Service Redis Master Node Failover DNS TTL Cache
description: Auth service continued attempting connections to decommissioned Redis master after Sentinel failover.
error_message: ConnectionRefusedError: [Errno 111] Connection refused to 10.0.4.12:6379 (Old Primary)
logs:
2025-09-02 18:20:10 ERROR [auth-service] Redis connection failed to 10.0.4.12: node demoted to replica
2025-09-02 18:20:15 WARN [auth-service] DNS resolution cached old IP for redis.internal.net
root_cause: JVM/Python runtime cached DNS lookup indefinitely, ignoring DNS TTL of 5 seconds.
resolution_steps:
1. Restarted auth-service instances to flush runtime DNS resolution cache.
2. Verified connection established to new Redis primary at 10.0.4.15.
3. Verified token generation healthy.
engineer_feedback: Restarting the auth pods cleared the stale DNS cache immediately.

title: Order Service Distributed Lock Expiration Race Condition
description: Double-fulfillment of single customer orders occurred during slow warehouse API responses.
error_message: DuplicateOrderException: Order ORD-9921 already marked as FULFILLED by worker_b
logs:
2025-08-19 12:44:00 WARN [order-service] Redlock lease time (5000ms) expired before worker_a completed fulfillment
2025-08-19 12:44:06 ERROR [order-service] Worker_b acquired released lock and re-processed order ORD-9921
root_cause: Redlock TTL was 5s while downstream fulfillment API took 8s under load, releasing lock prematurely.
resolution_steps:
1. Scaled lock lease time to 30s with auto-extension heartbeat.
2. Restarted order-service workers.
3. Verified zero duplicate fulfillments in subsequent 24 hours.
engineer_feedback: Increasing lock lease time and restarting workers eliminated race conditions.

title: Database Service Autovacuum Freezework I/O Saturation
description: Database disk read latency spiked to 450ms during aggressive autovacuum freeze on 500M row transactions table.
error_message: SlowQueryError: SELECT * FROM transactions query took 18200ms (threshold 1000ms)
logs:
2025-07-08 02:00:15 INFO [database-service] autovacuum: processing to prevent wraparound on transactions
2025-07-08 02:05:10 ERROR [database-service] Disk I/O queue length 128, throughput throttled by cloud disk IOP limit
root_cause: Autovacuum cost limit was set too high, consuming 100% of provisioned IOPS.
resolution_steps:
1. Throttled autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit to 200.
2. Terminated aggressive vacuum workers.
3. Verified query latency returned to <15ms.
engineer_feedback: Throttling vacuum cost limit lowered disk contention immediately.

title: Payment API Webhook HMAC Signature Mismatch After Deployment
description: Post-release v2.2.4 caused all incoming webhook callbacks to fail with HTTP 400 invalid signature.
error_message: InvalidSignatureError: Webhook signature header 'Stripe-Signature' does not match computed hash
logs:
2025-06-11 15:30:10 ERROR [payment-api] [security.py:56] HMAC comparison failed: expected b9a..., computed 84f...
2025-06-11 15:30:15 WARN [payment-api] Body payload consumed and mutated by logging middleware before hash compute
root_cause: Logging middleware formatted JSON payload before HMAC signature validation, stripping whitespace and altering hash.
resolution_steps:
1. Rolled back deployment to v2.2.3.
2. Verified webhook verification success rate returned to 100%.
3. Queued retry for missed webhook payloads.
engineer_feedback: Rolling back to v2.2.3 restored raw body verification instantly.

title: Auth Service OpenSSL Memory Leak Under TLS Renegotiation
description: Auth service memory climbed by 100MB/hour until pods crashed every 6 hours.
error_message: MemoryError: glibc memory allocation failed in SSL_accept
logs:
2025-05-19 11:00:00 WARN [auth-service] Pod auth-service-x829 memory at 88% capacity
2025-05-19 12:15:00 FATAL [auth-service] Out of memory crash in worker thread 4
root_cause: Vulnerability in legacy OpenSSL library leaking buffers during TLS session tickets.
resolution_steps:
1. Performed service restart of auth-service.
2. Upgraded base runtime image to patched TLS library.
3. Verified memory consumption stabilized at 180MB flat.
engineer_feedback: Restarting temporarily cleared memory; patch permanently resolved leak.

title: User Service GraphQL Query Complexity Denial of Service
description: Nested GraphQL queries with depth 15 saturated CPU across all user service replicas.
error_message: QueryComplexityExceeded: GraphQL query execution time 45200ms exceeded 2000ms SLA
logs:
2025-04-03 20:10:00 ERROR [user-service] [graphql.py:112] Deep recursive query executed: user -> friends -> friends -> posts -> comments
2025-04-03 20:10:05 WARN [user-service] CPU utilization 100% across all 4 pods
root_cause: Query depth and complexity analysis middleware was disabled in staging config sync.
resolution_steps:
1. Enabled GraphQL query depth limit (max depth 5) via config update.
2. Restarted user-service pods.
3. Verified CPU dropped to 18%.
engineer_feedback: Applied depth limit and restarted user-service. CPU normalized immediately.

title: Database Service Replication Slot Lag Saturation
description: Standby read replica lagged by 45 minutes behind primary, serving stale customer account balances.
error_message: ReplicationLagWarning: pg_stat_replication replay_lag at 2700s (threshold 10s)
logs:
2025-03-12 14:00:10 WARN [database-service] Replica standby-01 lag: 2840 seconds
2025-03-12 14:00:15 ERROR [database-service] Network buffer overflow on replication stream socket
root_cause: High-volume analytical query on read replica acquired exclusive lock on table being updated by replication worker.
resolution_steps:
1. Terminated blocking query PID on read replica.
2. Configured max_standby_streaming_delay to 30s.
3. Verified replication lag caught up to 0s in 3 minutes.
engineer_feedback: Terminating the blocking analytics lock on replica caught up the replication stream instantly.

title: Order Service Stripe Idempotency Key Collision
description: Checkout button double-clicks triggered 409 Conflict error instead of returning existing order confirmation.
error_message: HTTP 409 Conflict: Idempotency key 'idemp_cart_9931' currently in-flight by another request
logs:
2025-02-01 17:45:00 WARN [order-service] Idempotency key locked: idemp_cart_9931
2025-02-01 17:45:02 ERROR [order-service] 409 Conflict sent to client browser
root_cause: In-flight idempotency lock did not poll for first request completion and instead threw immediate 409 error.
resolution_steps:
1. Rolled back deployment to v2.7.9.
2. Verified double-click checkouts returned 200 OK with original order payload.
engineer_feedback: Rollback to v2.7.9 fixed the 409 conflict handling.

title: Payment API Circuit Breaker Stuck in Open State
description: Payment API refused all transactions with CircuitBreakerOpenException even after upstream banking partner recovered.
error_message: CircuitBreakerOpenException: Circuit breaker 'bank-transfer-gateway' is OPEN (failure rate 100%)
logs:
2025-01-15 08:12:00 ERROR [payment-api] Circuit breaker open: blocking calls to bank API
2025-01-15 08:15:00 WARN [payment-api] Half-open probe timer failed to reset due to corrupted Redis flag
root_cause: Circuit breaker state flag in Redis was missing TTL, keeping breaker locked in open state permanently.
resolution_steps:
1. Executed manual reset of circuit breaker state.
2. Restarted payment-api service.
3. Verified payment success rate returned to 99.8%.
engineer_feedback: Resetting circuit breaker and restarting payment-api restored payment traffic.
